+"""Decide whether a terminal should do markup, honoring explicit no-color preferences."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+from typing import TextIO
+
+
+def no_color_first(file: TextIO) -> bool:
+    """Whether the terminal supports markup.
+
+    Works exactly like :func:`_pytest._io.terminalwriter.should_do_markup`,
+    except a nonempty ``NO_COLOR`` environment variable takes precedence over
+    ``PY_COLORS=1``.
+    """
+    if os.environ.get("NO_COLOR"):
+        return False
+    if os.environ.get("PY_COLORS") == "1":
+        return True
+    if os.environ.get("PY_COLORS") == "0":
+        return False
+    if os.environ.get("FORCE_COLOR"):
+        return True
+    return (
+        hasattr(file, "isatty") and file.isatty() and os.environ.get("TERM") != "dumb"
+    )
